relations.text: MicrosoftのPurviewのData Security Posture Managementが、Varonisなどのパートナーソリューションと連携すると説明している
relations.text_en: Microsoft says its Purview Data Security Posture Management integrates with partner solutions such as Varonis

source.label: Microsoft · Purview Data Security Posture Management
source.label_en: Microsoft · Purview Data Security Posture Management
source.quote: This version of Data Security Posture Management extends coverage to third-party SaaS and IaaS platforms, such as Google Cloud Platform, Snowflake, and Databricks, and integrates with partner solutions such as Varonis, Cyera, BigID, and OneTrust for comprehensive risk insights.

relations.text: Varonisの顧客は、Exchange OnlineとMicrosoft 365 Copilot向けの追加サポートを購入できる
relations.text_en: Varonis customers can purchase add-on support for Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 Copilot

source.label: Varonis Systems 10-K
source.quote: Customers can purchase add-on support for Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 Copilot and ChatGPT Enterprise.

relations.text: Microsoftとの戦略的パートナーシップを発表し、次世代の職場向けAIの保護に向けてエンジニアリング面の統合を深めた
relations.text_en: It announced a strategic partnership with Microsoft, deepening the engineering integration between the Varonis Data Security Platform and Microsoft's security portfolio

source.label: Varonis quarterly results の発表
source.label_en: Varonis quarterly results press release (8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Announced a strategic partnership with Microsoft to help secure the next generation of workplace AI by deepening the engineering integration between the Varonis Data Security Platform and Microsoft’s security portfolio.

relations.text: Microsoft PurviewのDSPMとの連携を開始した
relations.text_en: It launched a Microsoft Purview DSPM integration

source.label: Varonis quarterly results の発表
source.label_en: Varonis quarterly results press release (8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Launched Microsoft Purview DSPM integration to help organizations see and understand their critical data across third-party platforms alongside their Microsoft data.

relations.text: Microsoft 365 Copilotを安全に活用するため、Microsoftとの戦略的協業を発表した

source.label: Varonis quarterly results の発表
source.label_en: Varonis quarterly results press release (8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Announced a strategic collaboration with Microsoft to help companies safely harness the power of AI with Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365.

relations.text: VaronisのプラットフォームをMicrosoft Defender for Endpointと統合した

source.label: Varonis quarterly results の発表
source.label_en: Varonis quarterly results press release (8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Integrated the Varonis platform with SentinelOne and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, expanding visibility to customers' endpoints and enabling end-to-end threat detection and response.

relations.text: Varonisの保護対象リソースにSalesforceが含まれている
relations.text_en: Salesforce is among the resources protected by Varonis

source.label: Varonis Systems 10-K
source.quote: The protected resources currently include Salesforce, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Google Workspace, Databricks, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Okta, Box, Jira, Zoom and databases.
source.note: 保護対象の列挙に含まれるものです。

source.label: Varonis quarterly results の発表
source.label_en: Varonis quarterly results press release (8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Announced AI identity protection for Salesforce Agentforce, providing IT and security teams with visibility and control over the data that AI agents create and access with Agentforce.

relations.text: VaronisはAnthropicのClaude Enterprise、Claude Platform、Claude Code、Claude Coworkとの連携を深めた

source.label_en: July 28, 2026 · SaaS transition and quarterly results
source.quote: Deepened integration with Anthropic’s Claude Enterprise and Claude Platform as well as Claude Code and Claude Cowork, enabling security teams to secure and govern the entire Claude enterprise suite with the Varonis Atlas AI Security Platform.

source.label_en: Varonis quarterly results press release (8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Announced integration with AWS Security Hub to provide security teams with advanced visibility, automated fixes, and proactive threat detection.

source.quote: Announced expansion of IaaS security coverage to Google Cloud, bringing the company's proven data-centric approach to Google Cloud storage and data warehouses.

relations.text: ServiceNow内のデータの分類とリスク対応に、対応範囲を広げた

source.quote: Broadened coverage to continuously discover and classify data and resolve issues related to data risk and overexposure within ServiceNow.

source.quote: Expanded our SaaS offering with coverage for Snowflake, which allows customers to continuously discover and classify critical data, remove exposures, and detect threats to Snowflake data warehouses and databases.
